# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# The checks that SHOULD be required on `main`, and how each one is run.
#
# Left of `=` is the status-check context, exactly as a ruleset would name it.
# Right of `=` is the recipe the job runs. The workflow contains no copy of the
# command, so local and CI cannot diverge.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTHING IS ACTUALLY REQUIRED. Checked 2026-08-25:
#
#   gh api repos/hey-vera/radar/rules/branches/main        -> []
#   gh api repos/hey-vera/radar/rulesets?includes_parents=true -> []
#   gh api repos/hey-vera/radar/branches/main/protection   -> 404 Branch not protected
#
# There is no ruleset and no branch protection. Every check below runs on every
# pull request and reports; none of them can block a merge, and nothing prevents
# a direct push to `main`. The PRs that have gone through review did so by
# discipline, not by enforcement.
#
# An earlier version of this file opened "The required status checks on the
# `main` ruleset" and singled out `mutants` as the one not yet in it. That read
# as six enforced checks and one gap. It was seven gaps. Recorded as LEARNINGS
# entry 13, which is about exactly this: a claim about a system outside the
# repository cannot be checked from inside it, so it has to be written as the
# query and its expected answer rather than as an assertion.
#
# Closing this needs a repository admin to create a ruleset on `main` requiring
# the contexts below. Adding a check then means adding it in three places -- the
# ruleset, a workflow job, and here.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

build           = just build
tests           = just tests
lint            = just lint
fmt             = just fmt
licence-headers = just licence-headers
cargo-deny      = just cargo-deny
msrv            = github-only: pinned toolchain, no local recipe (the host may not have 1.90 for its triple)
mutants         = just mutants
